findings.problem: Bare "gentleman" also lets a learner answer "der Gentleman", the common German loanword for a well-mannered, chivalrous man ("Er ist ein echter Gentleman"), so the prompt needs a hint pointing to the polite word for a man.
findings.fix: hint: polite word for a man, as in ladies and gentlemen

back.target: gentleman, (polite word for a) man; also lord, master
back.example: The gentleman over there would like to pay.

note: Herr is a weak noun (den/dem Herrn), which the editor might mention somewhere for learners; the trick's "never a hair out of place" leans toward the chivalrous-gentleman sense, so a trick about polite address might fit the card better.
